## Selected work

- Quarto — roommate & apartment-finder platform for the Colombian
  market. Branding + React frontend, both led by Mao.
  Case study: https://www.behance.net/gallery/107491479/Quarto
- SGD — mobile app unifying sports tournament management and
  synthetic-field (canchas sintéticas) booking. Expo SDK 54 + Supabase,
  12-table schema, row-level security for five roles.
- Insolvency platform for a Colombian law firm — Next.js 14 + Supabase,
  automated lead capture across WhatsApp, email and Slack.
- Nova — WhatsApp AI sales bot for an automotive LED-accessories brand,
  built on Kapso with an 11-SKU vehicle-compatibility catalog.

Additional projects (an automated MetaTrader 5 gold-trading system and
a construction-company website redesign) are listed on the site under
"More work."
